'''October 2001 Fort Worth tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Fort Worth, Texas on 7 October 2001. [[Justin Warren]] won it. It is known from Justin Warren's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3037">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-08-when-scrubs-attack-fort-worth-txd3037/ when-scrubs-attack-fort-worth-tx], DeckTech (Justin "hoostino" Warren, 8 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-08-when-scrubs-attack-fort-worth-txd3037/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 7 October 2001
* '''Site:''' Fort Worth, Texas
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Justin Warren]]
